notes: Recommendation/guidance only. Never copy these values into manual_* fields. Contains no sequences. Alphabet classification must not resolve molecule type.

audit_only.rationale: Length-boundary or random-kept audit of an otherwise technically eligible RNA record. Confirm the current technical route; do not invent a trim or assign a target.

primer_like.rationale: Source COMMENT identifies a primer/reverse-primer object. Confirm the proposed primer_like rejection. Do not repair or trim the deposited sequence.

non_aptamer_source_object.rationale: Source annotation identifies a non-aptamer deposited object (poly-A fragment or method/construct DNA). Confirm the proposed rejection. Do not treat alphabet_as_reported=RNA as RNA evidence. Do not park a DNA method object as a validated DNA aptamer.

molecule_type_unresolved.rationale: S2 molecule_type remains unknown. Resolve molecule/chemistry from source evidence, not from alphabet, T-count, A-only composition, patent titles, or ENA overlap. Preserve secondary length/ambiguity/construct diagnostics. Do not transcribe or guess a core.

construct_source_object.rationale: cDNA, transcription-template, or other construct/source-object concern without safe aptamer-core coordinates. Do not trim. Do not infer a core from T7 language without exact supported boundaries.
